question: Does the sign of the contemporaneous BTCDVOL futures-minus-index basis predict profitable movement in the traded DVOL future itself after fixed conservative transaction-cost stress and post-signal direction-matched public trade fills?

signal_rule.daily_anchor: First ordinary public BTCDVOL trade at or after 08:00 UTC for each active UTC day, strictly before expiration.
signal_rule.direction: basis > 0 => SELL/short future; basis < 0 => BUY/long future; basis == 0 => no episode.
signal_rule.nonoverlap: Within each contract, pair daily signal anchors deterministically as (0,1),(2,3),... . Unpaired final anchor is ignored.

fill_rule.ordinary_trade: Deduplicated public trade with block/combo/RFQ identifiers absent/null.
fill_rule.entry: First ordinary trade strictly after entry signal timestamp, matching the signal direction, within 30 minutes.
fill_rule.exit: First ordinary trade strictly after the paired exit-anchor timestamp, matching the opposite direction, within 30 minutes.
fill_rule.missing_fill: Exclude episode; never widen the window under this MVE ID.

fixed_cost_model.purpose: Conservative fixed research cost stress, not a claim that this was the exact account-specific fee on every historical date.
fixed_cost_model.rationale: Deribit's March 2023 launch announcement states DVOL futures follow the same fee structure as other USDC instruments. Public contemporaneous/legacy Deribit fee references commonly report 0.05% taker for USDC futures. Exact point-in-time fee provenance remains a separate promotion requirement.
fixed_cost_model.delivery_fee_reason: Every episode exits through a public trade before expiry; no episode is held to delivery.

bootstrap.statistic: equal-weight mean of per-contract mean net PnL

no_rescue_rule: After the canonical result is opened, do not alter basis threshold, direction, anchor construction, non-overlap rule, fill windows, quantity, fee/slippage assumptions, sample gates, economic gates, years or source population under this MVE ID.
post_pass_rule: A PASS promotes the mechanism to an after-fixed-cost execution candidate only. Historical fee provenance, independent replication/robustness and Promotion Policy V3 adjudication remain required before quasi-diamond or any live authority.
